components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA — Run triage, connect flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; background: #e86a33; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(15,17,21,0.04), 0 14px 30px -22px rgba(15,17,21,0.25); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(232, 106, 51, 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(232, 106, 51, 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Expand Bar
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { width: 100%; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #6b6b6b; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); border: 1px solid #e5e1d6; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; text-align: center; transition: color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out, background 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: #0f1115; border-color: rgba(15, 17, 21, 0.2); background: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(232, 106, 51, 0.4); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Context Textarea
components.description: Founder context blurb that drives triage.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-input" rows="4" placeholder="What are you working on right now?"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 120px; padding: 14px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #0f1115; background: rgba(241, 236, 224, 0.4); border: 1px solid #e5e1d6; border-radius: 12px; resize: vertical; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(107, 107, 107, 0.7); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(232, 106, 51, 0.4); }

components.name: Triage Card
components.description: Single email result inside a bucket.
components.html:
Prospect · high

Re: Series B timeline

Investor wants updated deck before Thursday.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 20px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e1d6; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(15,17,21,0.04), 0 14px 30px -22px rgba(15,17,21,0.25); transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(15,17,21,0.05), 0 30px 60px -32px rgba(15,17,21,0.35); } .ds-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6b6b6b; } .ds-card-title { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: Instrument Serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; color: #0f1115; } .ds-card-body { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: #6b6b6b; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Bucket Column
components.description: Act / Decide / FYI container with top semantic bar.
components.html:
bucket 01 · now

Act today
components.css: .ds-bucket { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 20px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55); border: 1px solid #e5e1d6; border-radius: 20px; } .ds-bucket::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto 0; height: 3px; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-bucket-act { color: #e86a33; } .ds-bucket-eyebrow { color: inherit; } .ds-bucket-title { margin: 4px 0 0; font-family: Instrument Serif, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #0f1115; }

components.name: Stage Pill
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #e86a33; background: rgba(232, 106, 51, 0.1); border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #e86a33; animation: ds-pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview: A founder opens the app the way they open a trusted daily brief: warm paper, clear hierarchy, no AI theater. Editorial serif headlines and utilitarian sans body. Density follows Linear. Motion is restrained.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral paper ground with ink text
Single ember accent for primary actions and Act today
Serif headlines + sans body; uppercase eyebrows
Flat surfaces with hairline borders and soft card-edge shadow
Bucket top color bars, not side stripes

rules.name: The Ember Budget Rule
rules.body: Accent orange appears on primary actions, Act bucket chrome, and active processing states only.

rules.name: The Bucket Color Rule
rules.body: Each triage bucket has one semantic hue. Do not mix bucket colors on unrelated UI chrome.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section labels are always 11px uppercase with 0.22em tracking.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flush with hairline borders. Shadows deepen only on hover.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Do not treat glassmorphism as a default decorative layer.

dos: Do use Warm Paper + Ink as the default ground/text pairing
Do reserve Founder Ember for primary actions and Act-today semantics
Do use Instrument Serif for headlines and Inter for operational text
donts: Don't produce generic Gmail/Gemini-style summary blobs without structure
Don't use playful startup illustration or mascots
